numeric.interpretation: Boolean gate values; no arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow.
numeric.simulation_unknowns: Standard four-state NAND: any zero input forces one; all ones yield zero; otherwise X or Z yields X.

verification.oracle: Independent truth table: output zero only for four ones; output one for any known zero; otherwise unknown.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 256 combined binary input vectors, then all 65536 combined four-state vectors.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait #1 before comparing outputs using case inequality.
verification.failure_success: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; print a line beginning PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: The original describes Boolean gates without explicit X/Z rules. Standard SystemVerilog four-state gate semantics are used; these supplemental checks do not change the binary specification.
